title: Willies Role
definition: The characterization of Willie the Librarian in the context of the CADMIES knowledge system.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of Willie as a librarian who wears black, bold frame glasses and has a Scottish accent. He's a scholar who knows a lot about the system.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Willie is portrayed as a gruff groundskeeper with a thick accent who wears black, bold frame glasses. This characterization positions him as a knowledgeable expert within the CADMIES system.
difficulty_levels.expert: Willie's characterization as a librarian with a Scottish accent and black, bold frame glasses serves as a metaphor for the systematic organization and navigation of the CADMIES knowledge system. This characterization also hints at the potential for humor and personality in a conversational AI interface.

extra_fields.insight: Willie's characterization provides a unique and engaging persona for a conversational AI interface, balancing expertise and personality.
